items.source: Rob Harrop, Jennifer Hickey
items.translation: Rob Harrop，Jennifer Hickey

items.source: Interface used by the MetadataMBeanInfoAssembler to read source-level metadata from a managed resource's class.
items.translation: 由MetadataMBeanInfoAssembler使用的接口，用于从托管资源的类中读取源代码级别的元数据。

items.source: method - the Method to read the metadata from
items.translation: method - 要读取元数据的Method

items.source: clazz - the Class to read the metadata from
items.translation: clazz - 要读取元数据的 Class

items.source: the resource, or null if not found
items.translation: 该资源，或如果未找到则为null

items.source: method - the method to read the attribute data from
items.translation: method - 用于读取属性数据的方法

items.source: the attribute, or null if not found
items.translation: 该属性，或如果未找到则为null

items.source: method - the method to read the metric data from
items.translation: method - 用于从该处读取指标数据的方法

items.source: the metric, or null if not found
items.translation: 该指标，或如果未找到则为null

items.source: method - the method to read the operation data from
items.translation: method - 用于读取操作数据的方法

items.source: the operation, or null if not found
items.translation: 该操作，或如果未找到则返回null。

items.source: the parameter information, or an empty array if no metadata is found
items.translation: 参数信息，如果未找到元数据则为空数组

items.source: the notification information, or an empty array if no metadata is found
items.translation: 通知信息，或者如果未找到元数据则为空数组
